newsitem.title: USA: Edison Int'l adopts shareholders rights.
newsitem.headline: Edison Int'l adopts shareholders rights.

text.p: Edison International today said on Thursday it adopted a shareholder rights plan.

"This is a time of dramatic restructuring and repositioning in the electric utility industry across the U.S., and particularly in California," said John Bryson, chairman and chief executive officer of Edison.
"(This) is a responsible and accepted tool for protecting shareholders' interests," he added.

The company said in a statement that one preferred share purchase right will be distributed as a dividend on each outstanding share of Edison International common stock. The dividend distribution will be made on December 3 to shareholders of record at the close of business on that day.
The Rights will be exercisable if a person or group acquires, or tenders for, more than 20 percent of Edison's common stock without Edison's approval.
The company said the rights, which will expire on November 21, 2006, are not being adopted in response to any acquisition or merger proposal.
